gantt.label: Gantt chart. Use the arrow keys, Page Up and Page Down to scroll. Click a bar to select its task, Ctrl-click to add it to the selection. Drag a bar to move it, drag its right edge to change its duration, or drag up or down onto another bar to link the two. Press Escape to cancel a drag. Point at a bar to see the task's name. Striped pieces of a bar are blocked time; point at one to see why.

taskInfo.title: Task information: {name}
taskInfo.projectDuration: A project's duration comes from its tasks.
taskInfo.name: Name
taskInfo.summaryDuration: A summary task's duration comes from its subtasks.
taskInfo.lagExplain: Lag: waiting time after the predecessor, e.g. 2d or 4h. A negative lag (-1d) is a lead. A percentage (50%) is a share of the predecessor's duration.
taskInfo.startHint: A new date sets the constraint “Start no earlier than” below. Links can still make the task start later.
taskInfo.startHintManual: A manual task starts on this date.
taskInfo.startHintSummary: A summary task's start comes from its subtasks.
taskInfo.startHintProject: The project starts no earlier than this date.
taskInfo.plannedFinishHint: Only for comparing; it never moves the task. Leave empty for no plan. “Set plan” replaces it.
taskInfo.actualFinishHint: A date here sets the task to 100%.
taskInfo.constraintHint: Limits when the task may happen. “As soon as possible” needs no date; types with a date use the constraint date below. Use sparingly: it restricts the schedule.
taskInfo.deadlineHint: When the task must be done. Normally it does not move the task; a red arrow warns you when the task finishes later.
